summary.intent: Execute Phase 36 (inline-upload-progress) which refactors the upload store to per-file tracking and builds an inline upload progress UI to replace the old popup modal.
summary.outcome: Both plans completed successfully across 2 waves. A React Rules of Hooks violation in UploadListItem.tsx was caught by the verifier and fixed inline before phase was marked complete.

repo: Upload store uses Zustand and was refactored from batch-level to per-file Map<string, PerFileUpload> tracking
FileList uses virtual entry merging to show upload rows inline in the file browser with folder-scoped filtering
The project uses pnpm as the package manager and has pre-commit hooks that must pass after each wave
Worktrees are used for parallel agent execution under .claude/worktrees/; a stale phase36 worktree existed from a previous session

code.finding: Early return `if (!file) return null` was placed before three useCallback hooks (handleCancel, handleDismiss, handleRetry), violating React Rules of Hooks. Hooks must be declared before any conditional returns.
Per-file upload state uses Map<string, PerFileUpload> with actions: addFile, updateFileProgress, setFileStatus, setFileComplete, removeFile, cancelFile, retryFile
Derives batch-level fields from the per-file Map to maintain backwards-compatible API for consumers that need aggregate upload state

workflow: The GSD verifier caught a React hooks violation that automated tests did not — verifier does static analysis beyond just running tests
Inline fixes during verification (when the fix is trivial and well-understood) avoid the overhead of the full gap-closure cycle
STATE.md merge conflicts occur when merging agent worktrees back to the feature branch; resolved by taking the agent's version
Post-wave hook validation runs once after all parallel agents complete since agents commit with --no-verify to avoid hook contention

friction: Stale worktree cipher-box-wt-phase36 from a previous session required manual removal
STATE.md merge conflict on both wave merges required manual resolution
Stash/pop dance needed on both worktree merges due to local uncommitted changes on the feature branch
